AEGIS-009.notes: Discharged by external evidence 2026-08-09. GitHub Actions run 31295058007, job 'Clean-machine reproducibility (AEGIS-009)', executed docs/ENVIRONMENT.md's canonical procedure verbatim on a clean ubuntu-24.04 runner (image 20260720.247.2, virtualisation.wsl=false), deliberately without actions/setup-python so it used the machine's own python3 as the document instructs. Every clause of the acceptance is covered: clean environment (the runner, not the WSL2 development host); instructions followed (commands_executed is the runner's own echo of the documented commands); no undocumented steps (the job has no step beyond the documented ones, and the apt prerequisites and the two CMake options it uses are now part of the document); builds (debug and release both configured and built, with pybind11 resolved from the venv and AEGIS_REQUIRE_BINDINGS=ON proving the bindings module was really produced); runs integrity tests (ctest 180/180 on both presets, then all seven test layers). scripts/check_environment.sh, the executable form of the document, ran and passed before the build. experiments/evidence/AEGIS-009/environment.json is retained as the development-host record; the clean-machine record is clean_machine_environment.json. docker/Dockerfile.dev remains unbuilt and out of scope: the frozen acceptance names no container.
